name: Aizaki Momo
source:
Momo and Pollon meet each other by complete chance—and when Pollon learns she’s being pursued by a shadowy force, he decides to help her flee them, staying ever true to his altruistic nature.

Momo’s background is rather elusive, and she is reluctant to reveal her identity. She is entirely unfamiliar with all forms of electronics, and has none on her when she first meets Pollon.

She appears 15 years of age. 

[Edited from [url=https://www.kirikiribasara.com/2022/06/08/anonymouscode-character-profile-translations/]Kiri Kiri Basara[/url]]
